book.title: 毛毛虫向前冲
book.subtitle: 安安的大班亲子运动会

moral.zh: 你挪过去，我挪回来。接力时，等在另一头的人也在为你加油。
moral.en: You scoot there, I scoot back. The person waiting at the other end can cheer you on.

pages.enText: At kindergarten sports day, a long blue mat lay on the red track. An’an sat at one end with a yellow sack by her feet. Mom waved from the other end.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide opening. An’an sits at the green-cone end of one long blue inflatable mat, her loose yellow sack beside her feet. Mom waves from the opposite end at the orange cone, her lilac sack waiting at her feet. Show about 10–14 other parents and kindergarten children watching and waiting for their turn, gathered mainly in two groups along the grass and far track edge in front of the school. Some children sit beside a parent or hold a parent's hand. Two child-parent pairs nearer the track look toward the game. Leave the whole diagonal blue mat and both ends clearly readable.

pages.enText: “Mom, wait for me!” An’an called through her cupped hands. Teacher Zhang held up the stopwatch. “Kids go across first. Then your grown-ups scoot back. The team with the shortest time for both turns wins.”

parentGuide.goal: 让孩子按顺序讲出谁先出发、在哪里接力，体会自己也能为出发的大人加油。
parentGuide.reminder: 读到“脚往前，屁股跟上”时，让孩子用手指指一指图里的动作。读到换棒时，一起找找安安和妈妈各在哪一头。
questions: 安安先往哪一头挪？她到了以后，谁接着出发？
读到最后，安安和妈妈各在哪一头？她们是怎么换过来的？
parentGuide.activity: 在桌上放两张小纸片当作气垫的两端。孩子用两个并拢的手指一点点走过去，家长从另一端走回来。交接时轮流说“到你啦”。

ageTips.age4to5: 请孩子在首尾两页找一找安安和妈妈，说说谁在哪一头。
ageTips.age6to8: 请孩子指着两端复述接力规则，再说说为什么张老师要等妈妈到线才停止计时。
